scripts.build: export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" && rm -rf GmsLib.Wasm/bin/Release/net10.0/publish && dotnet publish GmsLib.Wasm/GmsLib.Wasm.csproj -c Release && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r GmsLib.Wasm/bin/Release/net10.0/publish/wwwroot/. dist/

scripts.format:check: export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" && dotnet restore GmsLib.Wasm/GmsLib.Wasm.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false && dotnet format whitespace GmsLib.Wasm/GmsLib.Wasm.csproj --no-restore --verify-no-changes && dotnet format style GmsLib.Wasm/GmsLib.Wasm.csproj --no-restore --verify-no-changes
